purpose: Measure a longer scratch domain-pretraining trajectory while changing only the training horizon from P2-28.

startingPoint.rationale: Starting again from the same verified step-zero checkpoint keeps P2-29 directly comparable with P2-28 and changes only training horizon.

controlledDifferenceFromP2_28: training horizon increases from 100 to 500 optimizer updates
forbiddenChanges: do not resume the P2-28 step-100 checkpoint
do not change optimizer or learning rate
do not add answer weighting or task-format fine-tuning
stopConditions: stop after 500 optimizer updates even if time remains
stop if 10 minutes is reached first
do not continue beyond this run without another reviewed authorization
evaluation: record validation loss before and after
independently re-evaluate the saved checkpoint after the run
compare P2-29 step-100 trajectory behavior with P2-28 where possible from metrics
inspect whether held-out validation continues improving or begins to worsen
do not infer coding ability from language-model loss alone
